children: BIOMERICA INC reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $4.45M and a net loss of $3.78M, with diluted loss per share of $(1.30), an improvement versus fiscal 2025 results as revenue declined and losses narrowed year over year.
Revenue was $4.45M for FY 2026, down from $5.31M in FY 2025 (16%).
Net income: Net loss $3.78M for FY 2026, improved from net loss $4.97M in FY 2025 (loss narrowed ~24%).
Diluted earnings per share: $(1.30) per share for FY 2026, improved from $(2.16) per share in FY 2025.
Revenue decline driven by lower clinical lab, over‑the‑counter and contract manufacturing volumes.
Phased commercialization of inFoods® IBS concentrated on gastroenterology physicians, alongside lab sales of hp+detect™ in the U.S. and U.K.
Secured a CPT PLA code and a national Medicare rate of $300 for inFoods® IBS; initial Medicare claims have been paid.
Entered a marketing services agreement with Henry Schein and a CDMO master services agreement targeting more than $1.75M in development fees.
Reduced R&D spending as programs moved toward commercialization and management is pursuing improved plant utilization through contract manufacturing work.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
